core_obligations: Section case (proof lines 3204-3208): with a section sigma, F cap f_*G is contained in the image of sigma^*G -> F, a quotient of a coherent module, hence coherent (01Y1).

General case (proof lines 3208-3217): 05AZ reduces coherence to f^*(F cap f_*G); flatness gives f^*F cap f^*f_*G; 02KH rewrites f^*f_*G = p_*q^*G where p: Y x_X Y -> Y has the section (id, q-composed), reducing to the section case.
proof_roadmap: Handle the case where f has a section directly (proof lines 3204-3208).
Descend coherence to the pullback and commute base change with pushforward to reduce to the section case (proof lines 3208-3217).
